card.name: Partway through capitalized or syllabified words
card.fires_on: Marks inside a long word that is split up, either in ALL-CAPS warning text (RES-PI-RATORY, H-EP-ATOMEGALY, ALL-ERGENS) or in dictionary syllable breaks with dots. It fires at the split point, before the rest of the word.

modes.label: All-caps warning words
modes.description: A middle chunk of a long medical word written in capitals, such as respiratory, hepatomegaly or allergens.

modes.label: Dictionary syllable dots
modes.description: The dot between syllables in a hyphenated dictionary headword.
